_doc: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts. Speaks any language; the `instructions` field does the acting.

defaults.instructions: Bedtime radio drama. Speak slowly, softly and warmly, with calm pauses. Never shout.

man_young.instructions: A young man, quick but quiet.

man_old.instructions: An elderly gentleman, slow and gravelly, speaking softly.

man_rough.instructions: A rough, blunt working man, low voice, never loud.

woman_old.instructions: An elderly woman, slow and kind, soft voice.

boy.instructions: A boy of about ten, curious, quiet.

girl.instructions: A girl of about ten, soft and curious.

audiobook_defaults.instructions: Audiobook narration. Clear, natural pace; expressive but never theatrical.
